The Meme Story

Born in the mine.

While other cats sleep, Miner Cat keeps digging.

Deep underground lives a stubborn miner cat with one mission: keep swinging the pickaxe. Every rock is another chance. Every tunnel is another adventure. Every shiny piece of gold is proof that persistence can become a meme.

$MINEOW turns that character into a community meme: humorous, recognizable, easy to share, and built around the spirit of never giving up on the next discovery.
